ABCKids.au: The Rustler Roundup/ A New Discovery
Kai helps Bell track down stolen nerfs. Lys sets out to find a rare creature.
Pirate Robot seeks help when Night Ninja steals his hat. When Pirate Robot is left out of the PJs plans, he tries to help anyway and only makes the situation much worse!
Ranger Marsh retells the story of how Shellington was able to help, Ronny, a monitor lizard, find his brothers.
When Thomas accidentally breaks a light he's hauling to the Sodor Festival of Lights, he learns the best way to be the Number 1 engine is to be honest when you make a mistake.
Three paints Two with one too many blocks and realises disguises won't help.
When Mittens' cousin, Ropa, comes to visit, she over-plans the whole day, which threatens to ruin all the spontaneous fun.
Fantus meets a goat. It balances on a log and climbs up to eat from a tree.
George is sad when Suzy Sheep comes to play and Peppa won't let him join in their games. Later, when Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is happy to be the patient.
The Wiggly Days Of The Week

Join Evie and Dorothy for some graceful 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat Ballet.' Then embark on a week-long journey to explore the days of the week, discover the surprises each day brings, making it full of exciting adventures!

A film crew arrives to record a rare bird nesting at Mossybottom Farm. The Farmer is delighted by all the attention, but when a cameraman films the Flock enjoying a game of cricket, drastic action is needed.
With help from Bootsie, Team Spidey foils Sandman's theft of priceless Egyptian artifacts.
Evil Pea tricks Supertato and the Veggies, who fall into the deli counter and come face to face with the Turnip of Terror. They escape with help from the not-so-scary Turnip.
When the pets' Howloween treats go missing all over Kittydale, the SuperKitties must track down the thief, even if it turns out to be the spooky Howloween Cat that Bitsy fears.
The Wise Old Elf teaches the elf children how to tell the time using a watch, while Nanny Plum would much rather use a dandelion clock to teach the fairy children.
When a wheel-less golf buggy is dumped in the plaza, the neighbourhood kids band together to turn junk into art.

Flower decides cats shouldn't say 'meow' anymore, and soon Flour is speaking only in 'beep beep.' When Cockatoo takes a liking to Flour's new language, Flower feels left out as the two new friends romp around the plaza.
Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup with Madame Gazelle. The children will be learning about the weather by building a weather station.
Madame Gazelle has organised a Roller Disco for the children.
Not wanting to go to bed, Bluey tries to dream about being a nocturnal fruit bat so she can stay up all night long and soon finds herself flying through the night sky.
When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, cousin Socks grabs it and won't let go! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!
Fossilised honeysuckle is extremely yummy and extremely difficult to crack open. Ginger and the baby Pea-rexes must use all their clever thinking to open their prized meal.
When Ginger gets stung by an Appleflyus it leaves a painful and incredibly itchy sore but, the only way to cure it is with the tail of an Appleflyus!
The doctors realise Fergus' bog mud has healing properties. With everyone sent to the bog for treatment, Fergus starts to feel overwhelmed.
The dog and the squirrels decide to play hide and seek and Duggee finds them all except Roly.
Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A and E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and Penguins give us facts about what's hot, and what's not.
Why are flowers all different colours? How do different pollinators see colour? The gardeners create beautiful flower bouquets for bees, butterflies and birds.
Miah and Teo are exploring all things big and small within the home! Miah meets Petra the dog and five of her small puppies. In the big Play School pop-up book Teo and Miah find a small bedroom.
To make Wilf happy, the Piggies build a honking vehicle that ends up being very annoying for everyone else. When it breaks, Wilf feels even worse so they need to cheer him up.

When Santiago and the crew are put in charge of babysitting a gargoyle, things go awry when the gargoyle gets loose. / When Bonnie Bones steals a broom, the crew must get it back before the Night of the Witches is ruined.
Vida discovers the magic of Halloween and Dia de los Muertos with the Super Monsters, learning to embrace new traditions with courage and joy.
Ranger Nat's hike turns to adventure when he finds a treasure map, but he needs the Mechas' help to read it.
Nikhil and Jay and the Cuppa King
Nikhil and Jay help Appa get ready to appear on Mr Awan's channel to tell the world about his amazing Appa Cuppa! Can they help Appa overcome his camera-shyness?
After helping everyone else with their jack-o-lanterns, Millie finally settles on building a Millie-O-Lantern for 'Pumpkinfest in the Park'.
Beach shoes have gone missing, some red hair is found at the scene and Grumblestunk is blaming Stan! Who really did it!? Stan and Gran spy a mystery!
When Miffy wins a train trivia contest by repeating shy Ko's answers, she finds herself struggling with the duties of being an honorary train conductor.
Pants and Popcorn have fun digging the best hole ever, but when they forget to fill it in, Post Pig Petunia falls in and scatters her mail everywhere.
When Pants accidentally takes Mittens' new toy, it slowly gets destroyed as he tries to keep it safe.

Simon and Evie find a pair of glasses in the Wiggly Kitchen and they don't know what to do with them. The Tree of Wisdom is here to help! Sing along and learn the alphabet with the 'ABC Alphabet Song'.
The toddlers are visited by a duck. Fantus helps a little monkey find its parent.
One and Two are off on a camping trip, and together they have fun sharing things equally between them. Can they carry on sharing things fairly when Three and Four join them?
What else can cause ice to melt? Luke is fishing for answers in the Science Time Lab. Join him to discover the effect that salt can have on ice and catch an icy swishy fish or two along the way!
Miss Rabbit spends the day picking people up and dropping people off in her job as taxi driver.
Peppa and her friends learn how to play games of pretend.
Kiri and Lou have a big fight, but find it's too hard not to be friends.
Ginger and the Peas help a lost Avocadodon find its perfect pair with a head-rubbing ritual.

Holly forgets Ben's birthday, and rushes home to make him a birthday card. But Nanny has stopped all magic, so Holly has to make the card herself. When she takes the card to Ben she is embarrassed that it is hand-made.
Birdie is always out of breath. Vida helps him manage his asthma AND perform the coolest dance ever!
Angela and Tom need to work together on a rescue even though they've been getting on each other's nerves all day.
When Escarlata gets ahold of an enchanted guitar riff, all of the underseas may soon fall under her spell
Feeling left out with the arrival of new heroes on the team, Gekko tries to muscle his way into missions that don't involve him - overlooking a threat only he could prevent.
Running out of air, Barnacles struggles to free his paw from the mouth of a giant clam, while simultaneously directing his crew in a delicate Manatee rescue operation.
The squirrels find a treasure map inside Duggee's big shiny ruby. X marks the spot! Can they find their way to the treasure with so many obstacles in their way, like a Sea Monster and Giant Snake?
Gherkinn's family visits Kangaroo Beach, eager to see their heroic lifeguard son in action! But when they arrive, they discover Ghërkinn hasn't been entirely truthful with them.
Sarah is excited to shadow Sergeant Rose Ravani until she's stuck filing maps. But when Gareth gets lost, Sarah learns how important map reading is.
Nikhil and Jay and the Max's Friend
When Max the cat leaves the garden in the middle of a game, the boys are shocked to learn she might have other friends! They find clues to try and find where Max has gone.
Things get totally out of hand at a Square Club meeting - until a certain someone arrives to save the day.
Nim's cookies are going missing!  Who is taking them? Nim paints a spooky wax picture, makes a cool hobby horse, and bakes some new cookies, fossil style!
Ruff ruff! Did you know, dogs have their own doctors called vets and sometimes they even have jobs? See what it takes to be a police dog - a very important job, indeed.

You can't forget about dessert! Abi and Rachael are looking for a dreamy dessert to end the day. With help from dessert star Morgan Hipworth, they create a feast of watermelon pizza and banana and cauliflower ice cream
The Super Monsters bring Halloween magic to Pitchfork Pines, teaching friendship, fun, and the joy of community.

The pigs bullying behaviour is annoying all the animals on the farm when.a hero appears. Dressed in a costume last seen on the washing line and wielding a borrowed leaf blower; 'Super Sheep' restores peace to the farm.
Professor Kranium hijacks the launch of the Peak City Heroes' action figures by hacking into the toys.
Take home readers - best day ever for Little J, and worst day ever for Levi!
The Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team's new coach, but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs with chaotic results.
When Flower loses her first tooth, she enlists Flour the cat to help keep it safe and make sure the tooth fairy can find it.

Tammy meets the kids at the beach to explore rock pools and see the plants and animals that live in them. The team use jars to collect water and bits of seaweed from the ocean and observe the plankton and microorganisms.

Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are out with Grandpa on his boat. They are playing pirates. Police Officers Panda and Police Officer Squirrel are in their Police Boat. The children get to go on the police boat.

Peppa and some of her friends visit Mrs. Badger's Farm. Mrs. Badger shows them how the tractor works, and the tractor's trailer is used to drive the children around the farm. Mummy and Daddy Pig's car gets stuck in a muddy field.

When the kindy school's pet escapes from its hutch in the classroom, the Looksalotl, a shy shape-shifting creature, hides so well it might never be found. It's up to Andrew to find a gentle way to coax it back out of hiding.

An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.
Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
Iron Hulk and the Bees/ Fly Away Iron Friends
Amadeus shows off his high-tech bee hive, but when Swarm attacks, the Iron Friends must save the day and the bees. The Iron Friends stop Ultron from making everyone float away.
The tempting aroma of the Farmer's takeaway inspires Shaun and his pals to go on a mission to the local pizzeria, disguised as a human.
Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.
Pearl is sure Mara has Flailing Tail but when purple spots appear on other patients, Zog and Gadabout suspect there's something afoot. Will Pearl listen to them?

When King Tiger suddenly cries out that his ruby has gone, the missing jewel turns the party into a mystery to be solved. Luckily Duggee has his Mystery Badge and some enthusiastic Squirrels to investigate!
TAC discovers an Interstellar Treasure Map that leads Rocket Club on a mysterious and fun-filled scavenger hunt throughout the Galaxy.
Wizz is growing old, fast. Way too fast! If you keep watching, he'll be 100 years old before the end of the episode!
A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.
The children discuss that Atticus has been acting strangely all week and that it might have something to do with his parents going away. Atticus confesses that he is upset because he is starving.
The Jedi must free a wild creature captured by Taborr.
The Power of Mystery Mountain / The Power of Mystery Mountain Part II
Mystery Mountain breaks out of its dimension and floats over the city, the heroes band together to save the day.

Periwinkle wanders off during a mission in the Bialowieza Forest in Poland and discovers a rare European Bison stranded and hurt. They scramble to return the bison to the safety of its herd before a hungry bear locates him.
Thomas needs repainting and must be patient as he dries, even though he feels like he's missing out.
The Numberblocks have to do some clever counting to cross a sticky swamp.
Pants and Mittens can't find each other, but no matter where they look. They soon realize they have to think like the other to find one another.
How can fruit and vegetables be turned into juice? Fantus discovers that the machine runs very fast and makes juice.
Peppa and George are visiting their Granny and Grandpa who have a new pet parrot, Polly, who repeats everything you say.
Get ready for a Wiggly circus! Join in the fun with the 'Doing a Handstand' sing-along, and you can dance too! We're delighted to welcome Atsuko Arai, singing the beautiful song 'Haru Ga Kita.
An unusual guest lands on the Farm. When Shaun and Bitzer realise it's hungry, they set about trying to find it some food - if only they could get their hands on the Farmer's prize catch!
Who's the mystery hero doing good deeds in Windsor Gardens, and why do they want to remain anonymous? Will Paddington crack the case?
Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
The Iron Friends vs. The Iron Fiends / Vision's Invisible Trouble
Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.
When Silver Paw plots to drop a mirrorball onto a speaker and ruin the kids' disco party, Deena must learn how to dance to save the day.
When Aunt May unknowingly picks up Doc Ock's floating gizmo at the antique store, Spidey and the team must retrieve it before Doc Ock does!
Otto keeps getting a cramp while teaching dance class, so Vida teaches him to stretch!
Strange happenings in the kitchen inspire Flower and Flour to sneak downstairs for a late-night stakeout, only to stumble upon a secret that could lead to the best birthday surprise ever!
Peppa, Suzy, and Granny Pig are visiting Grandpa Pig in the hospital today. After the Doctor's assessment, it is decided that he is now well enough to go home.
Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them the importance of compromise.
The baby Pea-Rexes love to slide down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus, except for Split who is terrified and has to learn to overcome his fears.

Gemma talks Big Trev into letting the cadets stay overnight in the submarine for the annual coral spawning, but their dreamy adventure gets derailed when they nearly crash into a sleep-swimming Charlene!
Chaos unfolds at the clinic when the trainees accidentally zap Aisla with a Silly Spell.
Betty the ice cream van can't stop, so the chase is on for Mojo and Bo!

Jen has launched several flying camera drones that beam images of animals from across the globe back to Safari World. Mr Hammond notices some strange mud circles above the Atlantic Ocean - what animal could be making them?
Play School: Magnificent Monsters and More!

Abi and Albert decorate their bush cubby cave! They go on a drop bear hunt, create colourful monster paintings and meet Fauna, an amazing puppet who is the voice of the trees and can only be heard by children!
During a search and rescue drill, Penny and Annie's childhood rivalry leads to a river rescue on board Hydrus and Phoenix.
Zip and Riff get hurt and need special attention, which makes Aria jealous. She pretends to be hurt, too, but Hum can't take care of everyone at once!
When Wynona loses her squeaky hammer somewhere on the island, the friends retrace their steps and then realise they used their senses to find the missing hammer.
Guess How Much I Love You
When Little Nutbrown Hare discovers that he has grown a thick winter coat, he and Little Field Mouse make a coat from moss to help other creatures in the meadow stay warm.
Miffy loves to play with her brother, but she is used to having a bit of an upper hand as the older sister.
The seaside is a great place to find sounds, playing a seashell can even call a Mole!
Pants and Popcorn help Mayor Sourdough build the best playground ever by asking everyone what they'd like to have. But in the end, their playground for everyone forgot someone important.
MeMo and BaBa want to spin until they never stop. Together they find lots of spinning things on Planet BeddyByes and learn that it can be useful to take breaks.
Today Fantus meets a duck, a fish and a beaver.
A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.
Splash! Fizzy and Suds follow the construction of a swimming pool from the factory to a backyard, explore swimming animals, and create creative terracotta bird baths.

Get ready to stretch those green thumbs - it's time for the XXV Garden Games! The garden is bursting with energy as Costa and Clarence host the biggest, boldest, most action-packed event on the gardening calendar.
I Like To Eat Apple And Bananas

Tsehay and John are in the Wiggly Kitchen doing some meal prep for a post work out meal and they find an apple and Banana, what could they make? Sing and dance along to the classic 'Apples and Bananas'.
Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
The Iron Friends vs. The Iron Fiends / Vision's Invisible Trouble
Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.
Ranger Nat is bringing a playhouse on the train for Timmy and Izzy, but needs the Mechas to fit it through the tunnel!
Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
Nia is bringing a new animal to Sodor Animal Park. but it's an elephant that doesn't like steam engines!
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig discover how fun scooters are.
Madame Gazelle is getting Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
Kiri sings a song about how wonderful it is to have your very own body.
The gang rescue a trapped Baby Watermelonsuchus with the help of some Lycheemodus.

Queen Thistle reads the children a story about the stars, and they all wonder where the stars go in the daytime. They can't find the answer in the magic books, so go instead to the Wise Old Elf in the Great Elf Library.
Tidbit overpacks and gets so many booboos on his hike, that he wants to give up!
Angela tries to fight Gor-don the Great while having a fun friendship day with Becca at the same time.
Tomas accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!
The Wolfies want to master the PJ Riders, so they steal them to assert their dominance.
When a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.
The birds keep eating Duggee's grain. Tag, Betty, Happy and Norrie help Duggee to build an enormous robot scarecrow whilst Roly keeps a careful watch on the birds.

Gemma talks Big Trev into letting the cadets stay overnight in the submarine for the annual coral spawning, but their dreamy adventure gets derailed when they nearly crash into a sleep-swimming Charlene!
Moose Roberts is about to complete his epic, month-long charity sleepout challenge when James' craving for a toasted marshmallow starts a forest fire!
Nikhil and Jay and the Grown-Up Jobs
When Jay hears about Appa's big day at the allotment doing grown-up jobs, he decides he wants to be a grown-up too. Nikhil helps him be just like the other grown-ups in the house.
Meet the artist known as Seventeen, who likes to paint 17 of everything.
It's the Annual Teddy Bear Party, but before that a toadstool pot, some paper cup critter puppets and a teddy bear box are created in attic. Will you be joining in the fun?
At Nana's house, Bluey and Bingo play a game of Charades. Can they help the littlies stick to the rules?
Post Pig Petunia's mail van has broken down. Mittens tries to help her fix it, but it's no use. Now how will the mail get delivered? By hitching a ride on another vehicle, but which one?
Jump aboard the Wild Explorer Van with Matt and Michelle as they adventure to a waterhole, make tea in the billy and play the digeridoo with Sean! Through The Windows we explore the Australian bush.
Come sing and count with The Wiggles! Buddy is here to help you learn the two times table. It's a fun adventure filled with numbers!
Fizzy and Suds explore bridges! They watch a footbridge swing for a boat, a car bridge lift on pulleys, and a tall bridge rise straight up - supported by strong pillars beneath the water.
It's Halloween, and the l'il dinos are going trick-or-treating. But Billy is afraid of the dark and finds it scary to walk through the jungle. It's up to her friends to help her be brave.
Ginger and the Peas get trapped in an underwater cave with a pack of inflated Lycheemodus!
The junior gardeners are worried. Gypsy the dog keeps digging up the yard! With Clarence's help they create a fun and beautiful pet safe backyard.
The Legend of El Ratoncito Perez
The crew must team up with the fabled tooth mouse El Ratoncito Perez to retrieve his stolen cap and satchel from Enrique.
Buddy worries Amara won't be proud of him if he doesn't win a contest.

It's delivery Chipmunk with a parcel for Duggee, but why is it wrapped up like a present? Is it Duggee's birthday? The squirrels decide they should have a party, but they will have to keep it a secret as it's a big surprise.
Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.
Peppa and Family go skiing on Snowy Mountain. They find lots of their friends there including Mandy Mouse and her mono ski.
Peppa's pet goldfish Goldie is having a birthday party with an undersea theme.
Kiri is upset when she finds some strangers sitting on Rockaroonie.
Whilst exploring deep space, a meteor strikes Cosima and Dad's ship! Crash-landing on the unexplored planet of Proxima, Cosima makes a new best friend - Big Lizard!
The Octonauts And The Flying Fish
When a school of flying fish accidentally make off with a rare book belonging to Professor Inkling, the Octonauts rig up the Gup-B to fly after them and get it back.
What starts as a leisurely sailing trip for Frizzy, Spyke, Big Trev, and Aunty Bev takes a dangerous turn when their boat gets caught on the reef, and they find themselves racing against time!
The Super Monsters help Katya cure her 'witchy-ups,' showing the power of teamwork and creativity.
The Team swings into action to bring back the fun after Electro super charges the amusement park.
Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

When Aunty Mia and Aunty Nina need the alley wall repainted, Flower volunteers herself and her friends for the task. Can Flower decide what to paint in time for the grand reveal, even with Flour's energetic help?
Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at their uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.
Nugget makes Pancake a special bracelet, but when others get 'nuglets' too he's upset.
Supertato and Broccoli are investigating a trail of shiny things when they meet Captain Pak Choi, they're her shiny things and have been falling out of a hole in her ship.
Bam causes the Batwing to crash.
Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they find their games actually have a lot in common.

It's bedtime for Timmy but he's overtired and won't go to sleep. Nothing seems to calm him until Shaun accidentally makes a shadow puppet on the wall.  Eureka! They'll put on a puppet show to help Timmy go to sleep!
